name: T-Step
note: Named for the T the feet make. Fast footwork at 60fps is the family's known blur risk (library.json note on this style) — a reason the harvest must record frame rate, not a reason to skip the step.

calibration.why: No reference has been harvested for this step, so every threshold below is UNSET rather than guessed. The step is DESCRIBED here — which phases it has, which quantity separates them, which joints do the work, what can go wrong. How much of each counts as right is a measurement, and measuring it is what the harvest is for.
calibration.unblockedBy: content/references/sh_t_step.json built from >=3 independent instructors (catalogue 6.0); the thresholds are then DERIVED from their disagreement, never authored
calibration.whyNotHarvestableToday: Bu adımın sürücüsü diz açısı değil, ayak bileği/uyluk DÖNÜŞÜ — ve hasat hattı bugün yalnız DİZ-ÇEVRİMİ şeklini tanıyor (prepare_take.py: id=='top' + minRateDegPerSec üzerinden knee-mean serisinde dip arıyor). Arama parametresi yazmak burada işe yaramaz: yazsam da okuyan yok. sh_running_man ise diz-çevrimi olduğu için BUGÜN hasat edilebilir. İkisini aynı dosyada tutmak kasıtlı: fark, stilin değil ADIMIN özelliği.

measurability.tierStatus: Awaiting reference harvest: no take of this step has been measured, so its detectability is unknown. Not a low tier — an unmeasured one.

scoring.freeJointsRationale: The upper body rides along; shuffle scenes differ on what it should do and this app takes no position.

enter.valueStatus: unset until harvest — the metric is the observation, the number is the measurement

phases.note: The weight foot twists on the ball while the body stays facing forward. The twist is the engine of the whole step.

enter.valueStatus: unset until harvest — the metric is the observation, the number is the measurement

phases.note: The free foot taps out to the side and returns. It carries no weight, which is why it can be quick.

errors.severityStatus: unset until harvest — how BADLY this reads is a judgement about calibrated data
errors.note: The free foot taps but the weight foot never twists, so the step becomes a side-touch and loses its name.

errors.severityStatus: unset until harvest — how BADLY this reads is a judgement about calibrated data
errors.note: Weight transfers onto the tapping foot, which makes the next pivot impossible and is why the step stalls at speed.

reference.note: >=3 independent instructors required (catalogue 6.0). Tolerance is derived from their disagreement, never authored — which is why nothing here carries a number.
